The buying guide · 2026-10-20

What do you get the pilot who has everything?

When a pilot has their equipment exactly how they like it, another gadget can be the wrong answer. Look for something that celebrates why they love aviation: a particular aircraft, a favorite airshow or the pleasure of listening to a busy airport.

By Pilot Gift Guide · From the team behind ATC · How we choose

IN THIS GUIDEBuy for the story, not the equipment listGive them a projectChoose the aircraft they rememberGive them aviation between flightsA small gift can still be the right giftThe gift shortlist

Buy for the story, not the equipment list

A pilot who owns a headset, flight bag and tablet mount may not want replacements. Instead, ask what airplane they learned in, what aircraft they dream of flying or which airshow they return to. Those answers lead to more personal gifts. You can often find the clues in photographs, the airplane they point out at an airport or the model already sitting on their desk.

Give them a project

The LEGO Icons Concorde turns an interest in airplanes into something to build. It suits an adult who enjoys the making as much as the finished object. Check the available display space first: the completed model is more than three feet long. It may be a wonderful weekend project for someone with a dedicated aviation shelf and a poor choice for someone who travels constantly and has little room at home.

Choose the aircraft they remember

A Cessna 172 model can have a very different meaning to someone who trained in one than to someone whose flying began in a Piper. Confirm the aircraft type before ordering, and consider whether the color scheme or variant matters to them. A model does not have to match every detail to be meaningful, but your note should explain the connection rather than present it as a replica of their exact airplane.

Give them aviation between flights

For someone who enjoys following flights from home, the ATC app is another way to spend time with aviation. It offers live air traffic control listening and playback. Visit ATC.com to check the current app and access options. Pilot Gift Guide is produced by the team behind ATC, so this is our own product recommendation. We do not present it as an independent review or claim that it replaces flight instruction.

A small gift can still be the right gift

An ornament tied to their favorite airshow team or a cap from an aircraft brand they love can work better than an expensive technical item. If they truly want nothing, a note about a shared aviation memory may be the centerpiece. If they do have a technical wishlist, let them pick the exact configuration and contribute toward it.

For the collector

LEGO Icons Concorde

An evening project that becomes a permanent part of their aviation corner. A strong choice for someone who loves airliners as much as flying them.

Before you buy: Allow a long display shelf: the finished model measures 41.5 inches. Ages 18+.

$199.99LEGO ↗
A milestone keepsake

Cessna 172 Skyhawk model

The best model is often the aircraft with a story behind it. This mahogany Skyhawk is especially thoughtful for someone who learned to fly a Cessna 172.

Before you buy: Confirm their aircraft type. A 172 and a 182 are different airplanes, even if they look similar.

$249.00Pilot Mall ↗
A little holiday aviation

Blue Angels jet ornament

A small nod to a favorite airshow team. Add it to a larger gift, or make it the start of an aviation ornament tradition.

Before you buy: Best for a Blue Angels fan; a favorite aircraft or team makes a small gift feel personal.

$17.99Pilot Mall ↗
Off-duty aviation

Cessna patch trucker cap

A casual option for the Cessna enthusiast who already owns the flight gear they need. The navy-and-scarlet color scheme makes it easy to wear away from the airport.

Before you buy: Confirm they like caps and Cessna; a familiar logo is more personal than a random airplane.

Let the pilot choose

Sporty’s email gift card

Useful when their wishlist gets technical—or the shipping window has closed. It lets the recipient choose the exact accessory, size or equipment version they need.

Before you buy: Check delivery timing and available values at checkout. Gift cards have their own redemption terms.
